name: haven
description: Connect Codex to a scoped Haven instance.

interface.shortDescription: Use scoped Haven tools from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex terminal sessions to Haven through user-controlled scoped API tokens. Codex must use /api/codex/* endpoints so Haven Settings can enforce tool access.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use Haven only through configured scoped access. Check capabilities before reading or writing data.
